title: Social and Community Service Managers
description: Plan, direct, or coordinate the activities of a social service program or community outreach organization. Oversee the program or organization's budget and policies regarding participant involvement, program requirements, and benefits. Work may involve directing social workers, counselors, or probation officers.

tasks.text: Establish and oversee administrative procedures to meet objectives set by boards of directors or senior management.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts strategies; human owns operational judgment

dwas.name: Develop operating strategies, plans, or procedures.

tasks.text: Direct activities of professional and technical staff members and volunteers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Employee supervision is accountability-bearing human work

tasks.text: Evaluate the work of staff and volunteers to ensure that programs are of appropriate quality and that resources are used effectively.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI analyzes performance metrics; human judges people context

dwas.name: Monitor performance of organizational members or partners.

tasks.text: Participate in the determination of organizational policies regarding such issues as participant eligibility, program requirements, and program benefits.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts policies; accountability and context are human

tasks.text: Prepare and maintain records and reports, such as budgets, personnel records, or training manuals.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain operational records in structured systems

dwas.name: Prepare financial documents, reports, or budgets.

tasks.text: Provide direct service and support to individuals or clients, such as handling a referral for child advocacy issues, conducting a needs evaluation, or resolving complaints.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Survey design aided; administration needs human respondents

dwas.name: Conduct opinion surveys or needs assessments.
Resolve customer complaints or problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Establish and maintain relationships with other agencies and organizations in community to meet community needs and to ensure that services are not duplicated.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Interpersonal business relationships are inherently human

dwas.name: Establish interpersonal business relationships to facilitate work activities.

tasks.text: Recruit, interview, and hire or sign up volunteers and staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — AI drafts outreach; human builds candidate relationships

dwas.name: Interview employees, customers, or others to collect information.

tasks.text: Research and analyze member or community needs to determine program directions and goals.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Market research analysis; human interprets strategy

tasks.text: Implement and evaluate staff, volunteer, or community training programs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Training evaluation needs observation and human judgment

dwas.name: Evaluate training programs, instructors, or materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Act as consultants to agency staff and other community programs regarding the interpretation of program-related federal, state, and county regulations and policies.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Compliance guidance drafted; human verifies and owns

dwas.name: Advise others on legal or regulatory compliance matters.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Speak to community groups to explain and interpret agency purposes, programs, and policies.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Promotional materials drafted; human executes outreach

tasks.text: Analyze proposed legislation, regulations, or rule changes to determine how agency services could be impacted.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Legal change impact analysis; counsel validates

dwas.name: Analyze impact of legal or regulatory changes.

tasks.text: Plan and administer budgets for programs, equipment, and support services.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Budget drafting from assumptions; human validates assumptions

tasks.text: Represent organizations in relations with governmental and media institutions.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — External representation requires human presence and authority

dwas.name: Represent the organization in external relations.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Direct fundraising activities and the preparation of public relations materials.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Event planning aided; execution and accountability human

dwas.name: Coordinate special events or programs.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others
